title: Climb Bio, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Climb Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a securities purchase agreement for a private placement of equity securities expected to close on or about April 29, 2026, with gross proceeds of approximately $110.0 million. The placement includes 9,481,000 shares of common stock at $9.50 per share and 2,106,000 pre-funded warrants at $9.4999 per warrant.
key_points: Company: Climb Bio, Inc. (CLYM on Nasdaq Global Market), a Delaware corporation in the biotech/life sciences sector
Private placement of approximately $110.0 million in aggregate gross proceeds before fees and expenses
9,481,000 shares of common stock at $9.50 per share; 2,106,000 pre-funded warrants at $9.4999 per warrant
Pre-funded warrants have an exercise price of $0.0001 per share and are exercisable immediately until exercised in full
An affiliate of RA Capital Management is participating as an investor; RA Capital is subject to a 33.0% voting cap under a prior Exchange Agreement
Closing expected on or about April 29, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions
